data.name: Los Angeles, California
data.location_description: Our Hawaiian adventure begins with a brief stopover in Los Angeles, where we'll catch our first glimpse of the Pacific Ocean! Just a short ride from LAX, we can spend the afternoon exploring Manhattan Beach's charming pier and watching surfers catch waves. The beach town offers excellent dining options along Manhattan Beach Boulevard. If we're feeling adventurous, we can rent bikes and cruise along The Strand, the beachfront bike path that offers stunning coastal views. For dinner, we might check out the nearby In-N-Out Burger for a true California experience, or enjoy fresh seafood at one of Manhattan Beach's local restaurants. With an early morning flight to Maui, we'll stay close to LAX at the comfortable Residence Inn, where we can relax by the outdoor firepit and rest up for our journey to paradise.

data.name: Maui, Hawaii
data.location_description: Our Hawaiian adventure continues at the legendary Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa, where we'll have four full days to explore the magic of Maui. Nestled along the breathtaking shores of Kaanapali Beach, Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa is where exceptional location finds deep intention. While our Kaanapali resort's nightly lele kawa, the cliff diving ritual, has gained legendary status, it represents just one facet of the immersive Hawaiian experience that awaits you. Feel the spirit of aloha infuse the grounds of our Lahaina resort with meticulously appointed accommodations, a large lagoon-style pool, and soothing treatments at The Spa at Black Rock. Embark on exhilarating ocean adventures, from snorkeling amidst vibrant coral reefs to sailing on catamarans that slice through crystal-clear waters. Discover wide open spaces on our 23-acre resort in Maui for soulful reflection and a deeper connection to nature. Over 80% of our Kaanapali hotel rooms offer ocean views, the ideal vantage point for whale watching and the sun setting into the Pacific. Immerse yourself in Maui's profound beauty, where the Kaanapali Beach resort lifestyle was born and perfected.

additional_info.description: From snorkeling in crystal-clear waters and floating in our lagoon-style pool to private dining under the stars, sunset s’mores roasting, and 3 miles of white sandy beach, our Kaanapali beach hotel offers matchless adventure by land and sea

data.name: Waikiki Beach, Hawaii
data.location_description: Vivid by day, vibrant by night: Experience the new Sheraton Waikiki. Immerse yourself in the beauty of Oahu and our world-renowned Waikiki Beach resort at Sheraton Waikiki. Step into our exceptional oceanfront resort, which features newly renovated rooms and suites with spectacular ocean views. The Oahu resort is located on Waikiki Beach, just minutes from some of Honolulu's top attractions like Diamond Head Crater. Upscale shopping and family activities are located within walking distance. After a day exploring Hawaii, relax in our Waikiki resort’s award-winning outdoor pools, work out in our modern fitness center or dine on globally inspired cuisine at one of our hotel’s restaurants.
